title: Display library K-means assignments
description: You inspect the optional fit and plot its assignments and centers.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You fit three clusters when SKLEARN_AVAILABLE is true. The constructor requests ten initializations and the supplied random_state, then exposes labels and centers.

steps.question: Which values determine point colors and which determine the large x markers?
steps.answer: labs determines observation colors. centers_skl supplies the coordinates drawn with large x markers.

steps.description: You plot observations and centers in the first two feature coordinates. The title identifies the library K-means assignments.
You print a skip message when the availability guard fails. The supplied output contains no numeric centers or assignments.
